Whole-root replacement used repeated sibling-list copies for every detached owner. Cache parent-to-child positions only within one synchronous read phase, and build paths by push/reverse. Matching and layout mapping use separate caches; removed-subtree traversal reads each child list once. Four 500-owner distinct/repeated and layout/no-layout fixtures keep exact outputs, release old leases and bound the shared root child-list reads to three.

Use a non-global Unicode predicate and share identifier pattern checks without repeating whitespace normalization. Unicode, combining-mark and distant-letter cases retain their existing meaning.
